valida.title: Title of the «Validate mzML» window; {name} = file name (already protected).
valida.caption: Caption and accessible name of the table of problems found; {name} = file name.
valida.counts: Validation summary line; {spectra}, {chroms} = number of spectra and chromatograms in the file; {errors}, {warnings} = number of errors and warnings.
valida.more: Note under the table when there are more problems than rows shown; {n} = rows shown, {total} = problems found.
valida.fail: Message when the validation did not succeed; {detail} = technical cause (error text).
